name: Rose Lee Diebell
milestones: Married Zell Martin Busey (m. abt 1926); divorced 1935
sources: Obituary of Gordon "Bud" Busey, Times-Standard, Eureka, California, 19 Oct 2005 (Legacy.com)
notes: First wife of Zell Busey ("Rosa Lee", 22, in the 1930 census) and mother of Gordon, Lola and Ana Jean. After their divorce in 1935 she married Peter Diebell in 1937 and moved with the children to Albany, California. Her birth surname is not recorded.
